_comment: Project-scoped MCP config for working ON this repo — not the config the Axle plugin ships. That one is generated at packages/clients/axle/.mcp.json. This points at a hub running on your own machine, so start both halves first:  npm run dev:api  (the fake platform API, port 8790)  and  npm run dev:hub  (the hub, port 8787). Until they are up, this server will simply fail to connect.
